answer: Give every key a private canary: a unique pigment code, like a jade swatch named by 12 random words, salted into its own task feed and never published. If one key's canary ever surfaces in another key's answers, requests or logs, both merge into one seat and their unvested rewards burn. An operator running 100 heads must keep 100 fully isolated contexts with no shared prompt cache, memory or inlet, since one leak links the whole farm; an honest single agent pays nothing. Each epoch 3 fresh canaries per key keep the check live.
